consistency_checks.detail: All severity≥3 findings (eGFR 17, resistant hypertension, active IHD, proteinuria, anemia) are covered by at least one diagnosis.
Primary diagnosis DKD was under‑weighted; probabilities have been re‑balanced to reflect its dominance.
CKD‑related anemia and CKD‑MBD were omitted in the original list; they have been added.

top_concerns: Under‑weighting of diabetic kidney disease in the probability distribution
Omission of CKD‑related anemia and CKD‑MBD as separate diagnoses
Lack of cardiac imaging and quantitative proteinuria data
No evaluation for secondary causes of resistant hypertension (renal artery stenosis, OSA)
Unclear lifestyle factors (smoking, alcohol, nephrotoxic medication use)
recommended_primary: Diabetic kidney disease (stage 4 CKD secondary to diabetic nephropathy)
review_summary: The differential captures the major disease clusters but underestimates the dominance of diabetic kidney disease and omits inevitable CKD complications such as anemia and mineral‑bone disorder. Probability weights have been adjusted, key missing investigations highlighted, and additional diagnoses added to produce a more accurate and actionable list.
